summary: The iOS offline banner's reconnect action retries a failed or refused Fabric carrier as well as any existing collections feed, so restored grants can reconnect without leaving the foreground.

schema.detail: No stored data or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Fabric admission, route fallback, retry timers and the first-collections-snapshot definition of live are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The existing carrier retry and collections reconnect operations are reused; no server change is required.

manual.detail: No migration or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting the app change restores the previous reconnect behavior without changing persisted state.
